title: Users with and without Create & Edit see the same Part Library toolbar
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • User {User-A} is an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • User {User-B} is a second staff login you hold, with the custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBVIEW), which has the Parts Department and only 'Part Library & Inventory → View' (no Create & Edit, no Delete).
  • You have a second browser, or a private window, so that both users can be signed in at the same time.
custom_steps:
1. In browser 1, signed in as {User-A}, click Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Read every control in the title row and toolbar, from left to right.
  3. In browser 2, signed in as {User-B}, click Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu.
  4. Read every control in the title row and toolbar, from left to right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {User-A} sees the title "Part Library", Search, "Manufacturer: All manufacturers" and "Category: All categories", and no control that creates an entry.
  • Step 4: {User-B} sees exactly the same title and toolbar controls as {User-A}. Nothing is added or missing for either user.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-R7, S11-R1, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy.
